facts.fact: Sierra Leone, Liberia and Guinea officials, with TRANSCO CLSG and consultancy TACTIS, agreed at an Abidjan workshop on a consensus to commercialise excess fibre capacity on the TRANSCO CLSG network and a roadmap to operationalise it before the end of 2026; the workshop date is not given, so the document's published date of 2026-06-16 is used.
